answer: Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, held in escrow until finality, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the river of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The meadow lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the opal is where a second reviewer recomputes them.
